purpose: Establish evidence-backed lead fit, need, constraints, timing, urgency and routing without inventing customer facts.
inputs: lead/customer reference and authorized minimum fields
outputs: qualification evidence and recommended next action/routing
gate: Qualification facts are traceable to source/customer statements, inference is labeled, required unknowns remain explicit, and no unsupported score/status is presented as fact.
human_review_triggers: sensitive/high-value routing when organization policy requires it
